about: Reading record for the Beta-Alanine Lab: one entry per paper read, wanted or known only secondhand, plus a log of searches and what they found, so the literature review is not repeated. Numbers the page uses live in claims.csv, loading_observations.csv, washout_rates.csv and solubility.csv; this file says what each paper is, what was read, what it feeds and what it leaves open. The spec checks it against the manifest and those CSVs.
verified: Every DOI, volume and first page checked against Crossref on 2026-11-15; six were wrong when written from memory and are corrected.

statusValues.archived: PDF in sources/ with a manifest row marked ok

statusValues.citedOnly: known only through another paper; not requested

papers.citation: Trexler ET et al. 2015, J Int Soc Sports Nutr 12:30. ISSN position stand: beta-alanine
papers.design: Position stand and review
papers.role: Dosing, splitting and safety statements in the audit trail
caveats: A position stand, not data; used only for the conventional dosing advice

papers.citation: Rezende NS et al. 2020, Front Physiol 11:913. Bayesian Emax model and meta-analysis of the muscle carnosine response
papers.design: Systematic review, individual and aggregate data, Emax model
papers.role: Default baseline 22.9, response SD 6.6, placebo variation 4.1; the 4-week anchor

extraFindings.text: ED50 about 377 g cumulative intake; Emax about 3.0 SMD

caveats: Supplementary Table 1 mixes HPLC units between studies; no value from it is used without checking the original paper

papers.citation: Rezende 2020 supplementary Table 1 (docx)
papers.design: Study table, 26 studies
papers.role: Finding loading studies to fit; no value read directly

papers.citation: Yamaguchi GC et al. 2021, Med Sci Sports Exerc 53:1079. Kinetics of muscle carnosine decay, a 16-week washout
papers.design: 6.4 g/day sustained release 8 weeks, then 16-week washout, VL biopsy HPLC
papers.role: Washout half-life 4.6 wk (95% CI 3.2 to 7.0); storage share 4.4%

extraFindings.text: A linear washout fit was slightly better than exponential (LOOIC 395.27 vs 398.22)

caveats: Online November 2020, print 2021

papers.citation: Saunders B et al. 2017, Med Sci Sports Exerc 49:896. 24 weeks of beta-alanine
papers.design: 6.4 g/day sustained release 24 weeks, VL biopsy HPLC every 4 weeks, gene expression
papers.role: Six loading points; the long-course anchors (week 24 is a known model miss); TauT downregulation
caveats: Shows a slowdown, not a proven ceiling: 5 of 15 peaked at week 24, 4 still rising

papers.citation: Stellingwerff T et al. 2012, Amino Acids 42:2461. Two dosing protocols and washout
papers.design: 1.6 vs 3.2 g/day sustained release, 1H-MRS gastrocnemius and tibialis anterior
papers.role: Low-dose loading points (MRS x4.3 to dry); washout half-life bounds

extraFindings.text: Doubling the dose (3.2 vs 1.6 g/day) about doubled the rise

caveats: MRS wet weight; converted with wet to dry 4.3

papers.access: open, but 403 to scripts (supplied by the user)
papers.citation: Baguet A et al. 2009, J Appl Physiol 106:837. Carnosine loading and washout
papers.design: 4.8 g/day 5 to 6 weeks then washout, 1H-MRS
papers.role: Washout half-life (Spelnikov's exponential reading); excess-loss anchor; dietary intake

papers.citation: Spelnikov D, Harris RC 2019, Amino Acids 51:115. A kinetic model of carnosine synthesis
papers.design: Model paper
papers.role: The model form dR/dt = slope x D - kd x R; wet to dry 4.3; endogenous supply estimate 1.85 g/day

extraFindings.text: Calls saturation of muscle carnosine 'currently speculative'

caveats: The endogenous 1.85 g/day is a model estimate, never a measurement

papers.citation: Harris RC et al. 2006, Amino Acids 30:279. Absorption of beta-alanine and muscle carnosine
papers.design: Single doses 10, 20, 40 mg/kg plain and chicken broth; 4-week loading, VL biopsy HPLC
papers.role: Tingling bands per kg; plasma peak timing; two loading points

extraFindings.text: Plasma peaks 47, 374 and 833 uM after 10, 20 and 40 mg/kg; peak and AUC rose out of proportion to dose; baseline regained at 2 h
Muscle uptake is Na+ and Cl- dependent with Michaelis-Menten Km about 40 uM (citing Bakardjiev and Bauer 1994, chick muscle cultures)
Carnosine synthase Km for beta-alanine 1.0 to 2.3 mM; histidine is high relative to its Km
Split dosing kept plasma at 125 to 250% of the assumed transporter Km

caveats: Extracted text prints the Km as '40 mM' because the micro sign is lost; it is 40 uM (see bakardjiev1994)

papers.citation: Sakamoto T et al. 2001, J Nutr Sci Vitaminol 47:132. Human liver beta-ureidopropionase

extraFindings.text: Recombinant human enzyme inhibited by 1 mM propionate but not by 10 mM beta-alanine, unlike the rat enzyme; the authors say the rat feedback may not exist in humans

papers.whyNeeded: The only test of whether the human enzyme that makes beta-alanine from uracil is shut off by beta-alanine: the direct answer to 'is endogenous synthesis downregulated while supplementing'. Need the assay conditions before the page cites it.

papers.citation: De Brandt J et al. 2022, J Cachexia Sarcopenia Muscle 13:2361. 12 weeks of beta-alanine in COPD

extraFindings.text: 3.2 g/day sustained release 12 weeks: fasted plasma beta-alanine +133% (placebo +3%), sampled more than 8 h after the last dose
Muscle carnosine +54% (4.25 to 6.59 mmol/kg wet, VL)
Change in plasma did not correlate with change in muscle carnosine (r = 0.373, P = 0.127)
Plasma back to baseline 5 h after an acute dose, half-life about 80 min

papers.whyNeeded: Fasting plasma rises rather than falls during supplementation, the best human evidence against endogenous output dropping. Also a 12-week VL loading point in an older clinical group that could become an anchor. Need Figure 2D values.

papers.citation: Blancquaert L et al. 2017, Med Sci Sports Exerc 49:602. Histidine and beta-alanine supplementation

extraFindings.text: 6 g/day plain beta-alanine lowered muscle histidine 31.6% and plasma histidine 30.6%; co-supplementing histidine prevented it
Fasted plasma beta-alanine +123% (day 12) and +169% (day 23)
extraFindings.location: Results, as cited by De Brandt 2022

papers.whyNeeded: Histidine depletion is a second candidate cause of the long-course slowdown (Saunders week 24 gap) that nobody has tested; and a second fasting-plasma data set for the endogenous question.

papers.citation: Goncalves LS et al. 2020, Am J Physiol Cell Physiol 318:C777. Insulin does not stimulate beta-alanine transport into human muscle

extraFindings.text: IV beta-alanine with or without insulin (12 men), and 10 mg/kg oral with or without insulin (6 men): no difference in muscle beta-alanine

papers.whyNeeded: Caveat on the breakfast tip: the meal effect (Stegen 2013) is not explained by insulin in people. Needed before the food note says so.

papers.access: paywalled (old Eur J Biochem, may be free on Wiley)

extraFindings.location: as described by OMIM and later papers

'There are no known reports of muscle carnosine saturation in humans'

Painelli VS et al. 2018. HIIT in vegetarians and muscle carnosine

searches.question: Has anyone measured or estimated endogenous beta-alanine synthesis during supplementation?
tried: plasma beta-aminoisobutyric acid, uracil, dihydropyrimidine in supplementation trials
deuterium or 13C beta-alanine tracer carnosine synthesis
metabolomics urine or plasma during supplementation
feedback hypothesis in Harris, Derave, Saunders papers
searches.found: No human measurement. Rat UPB1 is feedback-inhibited by beta-alanine (matthews1987) but human UPB1 is not at 10 mM (sakamoto2001). No DPD inhibition reported. Fasting plasma rises during supplementation (debrandt2022, blancquaert2017, blancquaert2018). Only estimate is Spelnikov's model figure. Chicken metabolomics (PLoS One 2022) found 3-aminoisobutyrate up; animal only. NCT07404540 lists plasma metabolites, no results posted.

searches.question: Why do low doses beat the linear model (Stegen 2014, Blancquaert 2018)?
tried: saturable TauT PAT1 Km dose efficiency
searches.found: Transporter Km about 40 uM (bakardjiev1994 via harris2006) against plasma peaks of 47 to 833 uM: large plain servings saturate uptake. Mouse transaminase threshold (blancquaert2016) points the other way. No human Km; no head-to-head efficiency study by dose.

searches.question: Why does loading slow after week 12 (Saunders 2017)?
searches.found: TauT mRNA down in humans (saunders2017), up in mice (everaert2013). Muscle histidine falls 31.6% on 6 g/day (blancquaert2017), untested as a cause. Perim 2019: no known reports of saturation in humans.

searches.question: Does insulin explain the meal effect?
searches.found: No in human muscle (goncalves2020); yes at 350 uM but not 700 uM in mouse cells (santos2021).

searches.question: Is there a human GADL1 share of beta-alanine synthesis?
searches.found: Only genetic association and low in vitro activity (mahootchi2020); no share by route.
